ordering: Original relation-file order; duplicate word IDs within a book removed, keeping first occurrence.
meaningRule: Existing meanings preserved. Missing meanings supplemented by exact ECDICT matches and editorial entries; audio uses first usable Chinese sense, not frequency ranking. Full definitions and supplement provenance retained.

meaningSupplements.method: Exact entry matching only, typography/whitespace normalization; editorial additions and sampled corrections. No fuzzy matching or bulk machine translation. Dictionary matches are not all individually reviewed.
